stem: What is the most reliable way to associate a visible form label with its input?

options.text: Use placeholder text as the label
options.rationale: Placeholder text disappears on input and is not a label.

options.text: Use a label element with a for attribute matching the input id
options.rationale: This gives a programmatic label and a larger click target.

options.text: Place a paragraph next to the input
options.rationale: Visual proximity alone does not associate the text with the input.

options.text: Add a title attribute to the input
options.rationale: title is not a substitute for a visible, programmatic label.

explanation: A label element whose for attribute matches the input id gives the input an accessible name and lets clicking the label focus the input.
